events.title: SZDIY 开放夜：从一根线材讲起——DIY 与硬件项目的线材选型
events.venue: 香港科技大学产学研大楼 314-E（粤兴一道 9 号）
events.organizer: 深圳 DIY / Shenzhen Makers 社区
events.source: SZDIY 社区公告（用户转发）+ 每周四 19:00 例行栏目
events.summary: SZDIY 每周四固定聚会，本期由 Felix 分享：从一根看似普通的线材讲起，结合实际规格书讲 AWG、载流、压降、双绞、阻抗、屏蔽、护套、弯曲半径等参数怎么看、怎么用，并讨论线材进入真实项目后的走线、穿板、防磨损与受力、拖链布置，以及如何通过样机和寿命测试判断是否靠谱，建立一套从「看参数」到「做验证」的线材选型思路。地点在香港科技大学产学研大楼 314-E（粤兴一道 9 号），无需报名、直接空降。
events.title_en: SZDIY Open Night: Starting from a Single Cable — Wire Selection for DIY and Hardware Projects
events.summary_en: SZDIY's weekly Thursday meetup. This week Felix shares how to choose wires and cables for DIY and hardware projects: reading real datasheets for AWG, current capacity, voltage drop, twisted pairs, impedance, shielding, jackets and bend radius, plus routing, board pass-through, protection against wear and strain, drag-chain layout, and judging reliability through prototypes and lifetime testing — a workflow from reading specs to validation. Venue: Room 314-E, HKUST Industry-University-Research Building, 9 Yuexing 1st Road. No registration — just drop in.
events.venue_en: Room 314-E, HKUST Industry-University-Research Building (9 Yuexing 1st Road)
events.title_tw: SZDIY 開放夜：從一根線材講起——DIY 與硬件項目的線材選型
events.summary_tw: SZDIY 每週四固定聚會，本期由 Felix 分享：從一根看似普通的線材講起，結合實際規格書講 AWG、載流、壓降、雙絞、阻抗、屏蔽、護套、彎曲半徑等參數怎麼看、怎麼用，並討論線材進入真實項目後的走線、穿板、防磨損與受力、拖鏈佈置，以及如何通過樣機和壽命測試判斷是否靠譜，建立一套從「看參數」到「做驗證」的線材選型思路。地點在香港科技大學產學研大樓 314-E（粵興一道 9 號），無需報名、直接空降。

events.title: 美股交易员策略沙龙深圳站
events.venue: 南山区粤海街道中科纳能大厦A座888
events.summary: 本次美股交易沙龙会（深圳站），面向想要入局美股市场、深耕海外交易的爱好者与交易者，不管是刚接触美股的新手，还是有交易经验、想要优化自身体系的交易者，都欢迎到场交流。现场我们会一起拆解当下美股市场整体趋势，解读板块轮动逻辑，分享实用的交易思路与风控策略，理清美联储政策、宏观数据对美股行情带来的影响，同时探讨美股上市公司长期发展逻辑、上市孵化与资产上链的未来方向
events.title_en: US Stock Trader Strategy Salon, Shenzhen Stop
events.summary_en: This US stock trading salon (Shenzhen stop) is for enthusiasts and traders who want to enter the US stock market and deepen their overseas trading. Whether you are a beginner just getting into US stocks or an experienced trader wanting to optimize your system, you are welcome to join and exchange ideas. On site, we will together break down the current overall trend of the US stock market, interpret sector rotation logic, share practical trading ideas and risk control strategies, clarify the impact of Federal Reserve policy and macroeconomic data on US stock movements, and explore the long-term development logic of US-listed companies and the future direction of listing incubation and asset on-chaining.
events.venue_en: 888, Building A, Zhongke Naneng Building, Yuehai Subdistrict, Nanshan District

events.title: 佛学与生命智慧
events.venue: 南山区兴源大厦
events.summary: 人文经典 · 佛学智慧课堂 在纷繁的商业奔波里，我们常常向外追逐答案，却很少向内安顿自己。 11月29日，我们邀请中山大学哲学系龚隽教授，带来《佛学与生命智慧》一天深度课程。龚老师一生研究佛学，践行佛学，弘扬佛学文化。是国内少有的对于佛学佛教千年文化传承，有真知灼见的教授。 从《四十二章经》窥见佛陀本源教诲，读懂缘起性空的中观智慧； 看清执念、欲望与烦恼的根源，学习观照内心，在得失起伏里守住中道
events.title_en: Buddhist Studies and the Wisdom of Life
events.summary_en: Humanities Classics · Buddhist Wisdom Class. Amid the hustle of business, we often chase answers outward yet rarely settle ourselves inward. On November 29, we invite Professor Gong Jun of the Philosophy Department of Sun Yat-sen University to deliver a one-day in-depth course, "Buddhist Studies and the Wisdom of Life." Professor Gong has devoted his life to researching, practicing and promoting Buddhist culture, and is one of the few professors in China with genuine insight into the thousand-year heritage of Buddhism. See the Buddha's original teachings through the Sutra of Forty-Two Chapters and understand the Madhyamaka wisdom of dependent origination and emptiness; see clearly the roots of attachment, desire and affliction, learn to observe the mind, and hold to the middle way amid gains and losses
events.venue_en: Xingyuan Building, Nanshan District
events.title_tw: 佛學與生命智慧
events.summary_tw: 人文經典 · 佛學智慧課堂 在紛繁的商業奔波里，我們常常向外追逐答案，卻很少向內安頓自己。 11月29日，我們邀請中山大學哲學系龔雋教授，帶來《佛學與生命智慧》一天深度課程。龔老師一生研究佛學，踐行佛學，弘揚佛學文化。是國內少有的對於佛學佛教千年文化傳承，有真知灼見的教授。 從《四十二章經》窺見佛陀本源教誨，讀懂緣起性空的中觀智慧； 看清執念、慾望與煩惱的根源，學習觀照內心，在得失起伏裡守住中道
